article_summaries.title: Snow Days Events and Activities
article_summaries.summary: SOE's official news post announces the Free Realms Snow Days holiday season: scheduled in-game community events and TCG tournaments every day from December 18, 2009 through January 3, 2010. It explains how players find the daily event calendar in the in-game Game Guide and use the GO button to teleport to events.
